# Saka Fleet

> Saka Fleet is your car's friend on WhatsApp. Owners say fuel, expenses, odometer and earnings in their own words and get tidy PDF reports, gentle reminders, compliance tracking and driver management — no app to install. One car is enough; trucks, bikes, boats, generators and EVs are welcome too. Owned by Saka360.

Key facts:
- Support: support@reports.sakafleet.com
- Pricing: free tier (1 car, 1 report/month) up to Fleet Command (5 vehicles + add-ons); every new account starts a 30-day, no-payment welcome trial with everything unlocked.
- WhatsApp is the primary interface: message the Saka assistant to register your car, log records, set reminders and generate reports.
- Reports are branded PDF documents delivered over WhatsApp and email.
- Canonical data units: kilometres, litres, engine hours and kWh (EVs), ISO-8601 dates.
- Documents: receipt, logbook, insurance and licence photos are read by the assistant. On the Free plan only the parsed figures are kept (no original file); paid plans and the welcome trial store the original. Receipts are kept as tax evidence by default and can be deleted from WhatsApp.

## Pages
- [Home](https://sakafleet.com/): product overview, features, pricing, changelog and signup.
- [Live Status](https://sakafleet.com/status): realtime service health, incident updates and recent changes.
- [Privacy Policy](https://sakafleet.com/privacy): data collection, cookies and compliance with the data protection laws that apply.
- [Terms &amp; Conditions](https://sakafleet.com/terms): service terms, subscriptions and liability.
- [Data Deletion](https://sakafleet.com/data-deletion): how to request account and record deletion.

## Onboarding
- Web signup (sakafleet.com) collects first name, last name, email and WhatsApp number (E.164).
- A 6-digit email verification code is sent from security@reports.sakafleet.com; verification can be completed on the website or by replying with the code on WhatsApp.
- The welcome trial starts when the user registers their first asset with the WhatsApp assistant, not at website signup.

## API
- The website connects securely to Saka Fleet's own servers for the signup, email verification and the live status widget. Analytics (Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel) load only after you opt in.
- POST /api/onboard — create/update a lead profile and dispatch an email verification code.
- POST /api/onboard/verify — verify the code and mark the account email-verified.
- POST /api/onboard/resend — resend the verification code (rate limited).
